I developed 'Trick or Treat Scavenger,' a Halloween-themed NFT board game.  In this game, players roll a four-sided dice to move around the game board.  The board features various spaces, including house spaces where players can collect 10 candies as ERC20 tokens, and thief spaces where players must pay the thief with their candies.  Players also have the option to hire a thief to steal candies from other players.  To join the game, each player must own a Pumpkin Buckets NFT, which utilizes ERC6551 to enable the NFT to hold candies.  https://github.com/codechefsong/Trick-or-Treat-Scavenger

Finished creating the open source and public ‘THE NEW PLAYERS’ brief - Launching today: https://radarlaunch.app/pool/64d501ee081e901b9fdfaea9   See it here: https://docsend.com/view/hpkv9gtxdgdpszn8   In this brief we're focused on a future of NPCs inside and outside of gaming, empowered by AI & ERC 6551s...And the big question is, what happens when AI NPCs can have a bank account & identity card?  Inside is 4 what ifs with 3 case studies each and packed with questions to get your mind whirring. We hope to inspire brilliant builders from everywhere to build towards a better futures with NPCs in it.
